blocks.raw: ## New Feature - PDT Violations for LPMA Accounts
blocks.text: New Feature - PDT Violations for LPMA Accounts

blocks.raw: Beginning April 14, 2022, DriveWealth will implement new functionality that will allow for counting of Pattern Day Trades in the UAT environment for LPMA accounts. This new feature will provide a counter of PDT violations that can be used to restrict accounts from further violations.
blocks.text: Beginning April 14, 2022, DriveWealth will implement new functionality that will allow for counting of Pattern Day Trades in the UAT environment for LPMA accounts. This new feature will provide a counter of PDT violations that can be used to restrict accounts from further violations.

blocks.raw: The change will include updates to DriveHub as well as API updates to the [Account Summary](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/get-account-summary) and [Violation Details](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/violation-details) endpoints.
blocks.text: The change will include updates to DriveHub as well as API updates to the Account Summary and Violation Details endpoints.

blocks.raw: **This feature is currently available for testing in UAT.**

blocks.raw: Full PDT details will be shown in the [Violation Details](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/violation-details) endpoint.  For the PDT counts, use the [Account Summary](https://developer.drivewealth.com/reference/get-account-summary) endpoint. Note that for LPMA accounts, the additional fields are not applicable with the exception of    `patternDayTrader` and `restricted` which will be updated if a user is flagged as a pattern day trader.
